dataset_rights.mirror_discrepancy: Kaggle mirror CC0 metadata does not override original Stanford NonCommercial ShareAlike rights.
dataset_rights.reference: Robicquet et al. Learning Social Etiquette: Human Trajectory Understanding in Crowded Scenes, ECCV 2016.

decode: OpenCV sequential VideoCapture.read; no seeks; frame0-based raw indices; exact decoded frame count, FPS and canvas checked per clip.
device: runtime.select_device(auto) prefers RTX4060 with >=0.5GiB free VRAM, CPU fallback. Record chosen device and reason. No retry for another device after inference begins.
exposure_definition: Full video timeline covered at 1 in 6 frames, sequential decode; NOT continuous monitoring exposure or false-alert denominator.

ground_truth.coordinates: Scale reference-image xyxy by per-clip x/y ratios, then clamp to video canvas.
ground_truth.fully_outside: Active positive-source-area GT whose clamped area is zero is excluded and counted as gt_fully_outside_excluded.
ground_truth.other_class_predictions: Person predictions overlapping other SDD classes count as FP; no ignored regions.
ground_truth.validation: Validate all active Pedestrian source rows (sampled and nonsampled) before run claim; positive source area, finite coordinates; duplicate per-frame IDs rejected on sampled GT.

limitations: Six videos from only two aerial campus source scenes (coupa and hyang); no factory/customer CCTV domain validation.
Sampled 4.995Hz timeline is not uninterrupted monitoring or false alerts per hour evidence.
Pedestrian tracking only; no helmets, hazard intervals, incident labels, delay labels or personal identity ground truth.
Generated/interpolated and occluded Pedestrian GT retained as declared; compressed-video/reference coordinate scaling applies.
YOLO26n weights are used as-is, with no adaptation on evaluation clips; possible pretraining overlap with public SDD is unknown.
Fixed parameters and six-clip snapshot selected before any tracking inference; results are a public reference, not operational readiness.
TrackEval maintained PyPI fork 1.3.0 is declared; official Identity/CLEAR metric family implementation, no HOTA claimed.
ByteTrack buffer30 spans about6s at sampled cadence and differs from30Hz continuous processing.

metrics.aggregation: Native combine_sequences sums counts then recomputes ratios; never average clip IDF1.
metrics.family: TrackEval native Identity and CLEAR only; no HOTA
metrics.input: All raw pairwise IoU values; no pre-Hungarian filtering. Map identities to contiguous sequence-local IDs.

precision: Native Ultralytics 8.4.174 quantize=None (FP32); half parameter is deprecated and not supplied.

predictions.coordinates: Persist raw pixel xyxy then clamp to canvas; count clamped and zero-area boxes.
predictions.missing_id: Persist track_id=null and assign unique temporary one-frame identity only inside metric adapter; count untracked detections.
predictions.raw_receipt: raw_predictions.jsonl: native boxes.data each sampled frame before adapter validation. Nonfinite raw floats stringify for failure diagnostics. Valid canonical prediction receipt disallows nonfinite values.
predictions.validation: Finite confidence0..1 and coordinates, ordered xyxy, nonnegative integral persistent IDs, duplicate per-frame persistent IDs rejected.
predictions.zero_area: Native/clipped zero-area ordered predictions retained with IoU 0 and counted as false positives.

run_policy: One exclusive .tmp/tracking_runs/sdd-tracking-20261011.json claim before device selection/model inference. Fresh output only; no resume or re-inference after interrupted/failed run. Metrics can recompute from complete receipts.
tracker_reset: Fresh YOLO object per clip; persist True within clip; IDs local to clip.
tracker_time_ceiling: ByteTrack max_frames_lost equals track_buffer 30 sampled updates; at 4.995 Hz this is approximately 6.006 seconds, not 30Hz behavior. No interval-aware tracker retuning.

trackeval_provenance.compatibility: Maintained fork uses native NumPy2-compatible code; no runtime NumPy aliases, monkey patch or vendoring.
